scope: bounded direct-wgpu raster pipeline; separate device owner, no mounted-host or full G-1/G-2 acceptance

quality.sampling: 4x4 fixed subpixel grid, linear-premultiplied RGBA16Float render targets; straight sRGB RGBA8 resolve
quality.boundary_policy: Reference ray-winding and GPU top-left triangle rules differ at exact sample/edge ties. Exclude only independently identified samples within 0.0001 device units of source/clip boundaries from strict pixel comparison; report exclusions and worst errors. No blanket image threshold.
quality.geometry: CPU scanbeam winding tessellation with all segment crossing events, intersected path clips, explicit work and float precision checks; independent winding and sampled interior triangle-union checks

resources.glyph_atlas: 1024x1024 R8Unorm, 64x64 fixed cells, at most 256 exact glyph/raster keys
resources.image_atlas: 1024x1024 RGBA32Float linear-premultiplied, 256x256 fixed cells, at most 16 immutable image identities; manual nearest/bilinear textureLoad with per-source clamp
resources.eviction: only unpinned mesh spans and atlas cells; exact device/thread ownership, deterministic retirement, failed-admission reference rollback

corpus.image: 64x64 RGBA source; 32 independent immutable replacement snapshots
corpus.composition: nonzero/evenodd holes/self-intersections, 2 nested clips, 2 nested isolated groups, gradients, cropped transformed nearest/linear images, gradient glyphs
corpus.lifecycle: 20 scale/resize transitions, 100 retain/dispose cycles, forced real device-generation replacement and pinned cache pressure

measurement.clock: CPU wall time; submit-complete uses synchronous queue completion without readback; separate synchronous readback timing; no GPU timestamp or input/display latency claim
measurement.acceptance: Budgets stay fixed even if failed. Correctness, resource lifetime and full platform suites required; report timing failures as unqualified performance, not completion of the performance gate.
